name: Q2 2026 Product Launch
description: Full-funnel campaign to launch v2.0 to existing customers and drive upgrade adoption. Focus on concrete feature benefits and social proof from beta users.
target_persona: Content marketing managers at B2B SaaS companies with 10–200 employees. Technically literate, data-driven, frustrated by tool fragmentation. Primary decision-maker or strong internal champion for tooling decisions.
key_messages: v2.0 removes the coordination tax from content teams. AI-assisted briefs cut planning time in half. Bulk scheduling eliminates the daily publishing grind. Piece suggestions mean no more starting from scratch.
tone_guidelines: Confident without being arrogant. Use specific numbers over vague claims. Avoid jargon. Write for someone who has heard product launch promises before and is appropriately skeptical.

name: Thought Leadership Series
description: Ongoing editorial campaign positioning the brand as the authoritative voice on content operations and AI in marketing. Targets senior marketers, not buyers — builds long-term trust and brand recall.
target_persona: VP and Director-level marketers at mid-market companies. Reading and sharing industry perspectives is part of their professional identity. Not yet in an active buying cycle but are strong referral and word-of-mouth drivers.
key_messages: AI is a collaborator, not a replacement. The best content teams are the most systematic ones. Great marketing is an operations problem as much as a creative one.
tone_guidelines: Peer-to-peer, not vendor-to-customer. Use first person plural sparingly. Make bold, defensible claims backed by data or clear reasoning. Avoid thought-leadership clichés.

name: Customer Success Spotlight
description: Series of customer stories demonstrating measurable ROI. Goal is to reduce churn by reinforcing value for customers in their first 90 days and to generate referral leads from advocates.
target_persona: Existing customers 30–90 days post-onboarding who have not yet fully adopted the platform. Also warm prospects in active sales cycles who need social proof to close.
key_messages: Real teams, real numbers. Peer validation over brand claims. Concrete before-and-after results that map to outcomes the reader cares about.
tone_guidelines: Let the customer's voice lead. Minimize brand voice; maximize authenticity. Use direct quotes. Present challenges honestly — overclaiming kills credibility with this audience.

name: Holiday Season Push
description: End-of-year conversion campaign targeting budget owners who need to spend Q4 budget before year-end close. Emphasis on quick onboarding, team gifting angles, and annual plan savings.
target_persona: Marketing leaders and team managers with Q4 budget to allocate. Decision is often time-boxed by fiscal year-end. ROI justification is needed for CFO approval but is usually a formality at sub-$20k spend.
key_messages: Your team asked for better tools all year — give them the ones that compound. Annual plans unlock 30% savings. Onboarding takes under a day. Start Q1 already in motion.
tone_guidelines: Warm but purposeful. Acknowledge the holiday context without being cute. The gift-giving frame works for this audience but should feel useful, not commercial.

name: Developer Adoption Program
description: Technical awareness campaign targeting developers and engineering leads who evaluate tools for content teams. Goal is to surface API capabilities and integration depth as a competitive differentiator.
target_persona: Software engineers and technical leads at companies with 50+ employees. Evaluating tools on behalf of non-technical stakeholders. Cares about API quality, documentation, reliability, and vendor transparency.
key_messages: First-class API, not an afterthought. Integration in under 30 minutes with real SDKs, not just REST docs. Rate limits and error contracts documented clearly. Built to fit into existing pipelines.
tone_guidelines: Precise and code-native. No marketing fluff. Show don't tell — favor code snippets and specific endpoint examples over abstract capability claims. Respect the reader's time.

name: Brand Story Initiative
description: Evergreen brand narrative campaign to increase brand familiarity and emotional connection with prospective customers who are not yet in an active buying cycle. The goal is recognition and recall, not immediate conversion.
target_persona: Early-career and mid-career marketing professionals who influence tool decisions indirectly. They share content within their teams and are the first to advocate for tools they trust. Building affinity with this group compounds over time.
key_messages: We built this because we lived the problem. Our values show up in product decisions. We ship for users, not metrics.
tone_guidelines: Human, honest, and slightly vulnerable. Brand stories land hardest when they acknowledge imperfection. Avoid corporate speak entirely. Write the way the founders actually talk.
